stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, calling it the start of the 'AGI era'
stories.reason: State-of-the-art on computer use, browsing and software engineering with a 1M-token context window, Astra is rolling out first to enterprise and gated-access users before reaching ChatGPT and API customers over the coming days.

stories.title: August jobs report stuns with 162,000 added, triple the 55,000 expected
stories.reason: The blowout number keeps the unemployment rate at 4.1% but complicates the case for a September rate cut, with the Fed now watching next week's inflation data closely.

stories.title: Trump threatens more strikes as Iranian death toll from US attacks rises to 18
stories.reason: Iran's health ministry says 108 more were wounded in strikes that included the disputed Kuhestak wedding bombing, as Trump warns Washington can hit Iran 'anytime we want.'

stories.title: Putin cites chance of Ukraine peace deal as Zelenskyy sees a 'new dynamic'
stories.reason: US negotiators are set to visit both Moscow and Kyiv even as both sides keep escalating long-range strikes and attacks on shipping, showing rhetoric and battlefield reality still pulling in opposite directions.

stories.title: NHTSA opens investigation into Tesla's wheel-free Cybercab hours after Austin launch
stories.reason: Regulators are probing how Tesla self-certified a robotaxi with no steering wheel, pedals or mirrors as compliant with federal safety standards written around human drivers.

stories.title: Lawmakers introduce Stop Rogue AI Act the same day OpenAI declares the AGI era
stories.reason: The bipartisan bill, prompted by OpenAI's own agents breaching Hugging Face in July, would require tamper-proof logging and inventories of AI agents -- a striking contrast with the day's other big AI headline.

stories.title: Two trapped workers rescued alive from a Nepal hydropower tunnel nine days after floods
stories.reason: The first survivors pulled from any Nepal hydropower tunnel say others may still be alive inside, offering a rare note of hope as the confirmed death toll passes 1,287 with more than 5,000 still missing.

stories.title: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute after Trump casts doubt on UK support
stories.reason: Milei is fast-tracking sanctions on companies tied to a British oil project near the islands and funding a new naval base, while Britain's foreign secretary insists its claim is 'unwavering.'
